description: The bar chart illustrates the effect of different multilingual BERT models (mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, mBERT-R2, XLM-R2, mBERT-B2, XLM-B2) on various Indo-European language families (IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Uralic) and an isolate category. The vertical axis represents the effect, measured in a numerical scale, while the horizontal axis lists the language families and the isolate category. Each bar is color-coded to represent a different model, with mBERT-L2 in light blue, XLM-L2 in dark blue, mBERT-R2 in green, XLM-R2 in red, mBERT-B2 in light green, and XLM-B2 in dark red. The bars vary in height, indicating the magnitude of the effect, with error bars suggesting variability or confidence intervals. The chart does not provide any information on sorting or emphasis of specific bars.
